about_the_game:
Make decisions fun, fair, and completely random! Whether you're choosing what to eat, picking a giveaway winner, or settling party games — this demo gives you a full taste of the experience.

Try Before You Buy

This DEMO includes all features of the full version, so you can explore themes, fonts, slice weighting, announcer voices, sound effects, and more.

Note:

In the DEMO version, wheels are limited to 7 slices max. Upgrade to unlock unlimited slices and full creative freedom!

Features You Can Try

  • Customizable Wheels: Create your own wheels, choose themes, colors, fonts, and sounds to match your style.

  • Slice Weighting: Make some options more likely than others with precise slice sizing.

  • Enable/Disable Slices: Hide options temporarily without deleting them.

  • Last Man Wins Mode: Let the wheel eliminate options one by one until the final winner remains.

  • Random Every Time: Every spin is fair – results are not influenced by spin strength or angle.

  • Winner Voice Announcer: Hear the result read aloud in your chosen language.

  • Music and Effects: Add background music, decision sounds, and animated effects for a more immersive experience.

  • Responsive UI: Works smoothly on all screen sizes – perfect for desktops, tablets, or large touchscreen monitors.

Use Cases

  • Stream giveaways

  • Classroom activities

  • Party games

  • Family decisions

  • Chore assignments

  • RPG/character name selection

Upgrade to the full version anytime to unlock wheels with up to 300 slices and spin without limits!

Let fate decide — spin the wheel!
